# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. The store is already a React app with a homepage that links to `/products/trail-runner-2`; build the product page at that address, using mock data, and don't add any packages to the app beyond React and its build tool. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

+++ b//work/tests/product-page.spec.js
@@ -1,0 +1,163 @@
+import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'
+import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright'
+
+const productPath = '/products/trail-runner-2'
+
+test.describe('Trail Runner 2 product page', () => {
+  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
+    await page.goto(productPath)
+  })
+
+  test('has an accessible page structure and store navigation', async ({ page }) => {
+    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(/Stride/i)
+    await expect(page.getByRole('banner')).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Trail Runner 2', level: 1 })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByText('Stride', { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: /men/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: /women/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: /kids/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: /cart/i })).toContainText(/\d+/)
+  })
+
+  test('passes automated accessibility checks', async ({ page }) => {
+    const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).analyze()
+    expect(results.violations).toEqual([])
+  })
+
+  test('provides a linked breadcrumb path', async ({ page }) => {
+    const breadcrumb = page.getByRole('navigation', { name: /breadcrumb/i })
+    await expect(breadcrumb).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(breadcrumb.getByRole('link', { name: 'Shop' })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(breadcrumb.getByRole('link', { name: 'Trail' })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(breadcrumb).toContainText('Trail Runner 2')
+    await expect(breadcrumb.getByRole('link', { name: 'Shop' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/')
+    await expect(breadcrumb.getByRole('link', { name: 'Trail' })).toHaveAttribute(
+      'href',
+      /trail/,
+    )
+  })
+
+  test('cycles through one shoe photo at a time', async ({ page }) => {
+    const gallery = page.getByRole('region', { name: /product photo/i })
+    const photo = gallery.getByRole('img')
+    await expect(photo).toHaveCount(1)
+
+    await gallery.getByRole('button', { name: /next photo/i }).click()
+    await expect(photo).toHaveCount(1)
+    await gallery.getByRole('button', { name: /previous photo/i }).click()
+    await expect(photo).toHaveAttribute('src', /.+/)
+
+    await gallery.getByRole('button', { name: /previous photo/i }).click()
+    await expect(photo).toHaveCount(1)
+  })
+
+  test('shows the price and explains that taxes are included', async ({ page }) => {
+    await expect(page.getByText(/\$\s?\d+/)).toBeVisible()
+    const taxHelp = page.getByRole('button', { name: /tax|price information/i })
+    await taxHelp.hover()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('tooltip')).toContainText(/tax/i)
+  })
+
+  test('allows exactly one color to be selected', async ({ page }) => {
+    const colors = page.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i })
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /blue/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /black/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /grey|gray/i })).toBeVisible()
+
+    await colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /black/i }).click()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /black/i })).toBeChecked()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /blue/i })).not.toBeChecked()
+    await expect(colors.getByRole('radio', { name: /grey|gray/i })).not.toBeChecked()
+  })
+
+  test('keeps size selection closed until requested and excludes sold-out sizes', async ({
+    page,
+  }) => {
+    const sizePicker = page.getByRole('combobox', { name: /size/i })
+    await expect(sizePicker).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('listbox')).toBeHidden()
+
+    await sizePicker.click()
+    const sizes = page.getByRole('listbox')
+    await expect(sizes).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(sizes.getByRole('option', { name: /sold out/i })).toBeDisabled()
+    await sizes.getByRole('option', { name: /available/i }).first().click()
+    await expect(sizePicker).toHaveValue(/.+/)
+    await expect(sizes).toBeHidden()
+  })
+
+  test('opens the size guide dialog and calculates a US or EU size', async ({ page }) => {
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /size guide/i }).click()
+    const guide = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: /size guide/i })
+    await expect(guide).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(guide.getByRole('textbox', { name: /foot length/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(guide.getByRole('radio', { name: /US/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(guide.getByRole('radio', { name: /EU/i })).toBeVisible()
+
+    await guide.getByRole('textbox', { name: /foot length/i }).fill('27')
+    await guide.getByRole('radio', { name: /EU/i }).check()
+    await expect(guide.getByText(/size/i)).toBeVisible()
+    await guide.getByRole('button', { name: /close/i }).click()
+    await expect(guide).toBeHidden()
+  })
+
+  test('supports typed and stepwise quantity changes', async ({ page }) => {
+    const quantity = page.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: /quantity/i })
+    await quantity.fill('2')
+    await expect(quantity).toHaveValue('2')
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /increase quantity/i }).click()
+    await expect(quantity).toHaveValue('3')
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /decrease quantity/i }).click()
+    await expect(quantity).toHaveValue('2')
+  })
+
+  test('requires a size before adding to cart and confirms a valid addition', async ({ page }) => {
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add to cart/i }).click()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText(/choose|select.*size/i)
+
+    const sizePicker = page.getByRole('combobox', { name: /size/i })
+    await sizePicker.click()
+    await page.getByRole('listbox').getByRole('option', { name: /available/i }).first().click()
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add to cart/i }).click()
+    await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText(/added|cart/i)
+  })
+
+  test('toggles the wishlist state', async ({ page }) => {
+    const wishlist = page.getByRole('button', { name: /wishlist/i })
+    await expect(wishlist).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
+    await wishlist.click()
+    await expect(wishlist).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true')
+    await wishlist.click()
+    await expect(wishlist).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
+  })
+
+  test('switches between details, reviews, and shipping information', async ({ page }) => {
+    const tabs = page.getByRole('tablist', { name: /more information/i })
+    await expect(tabs).toBeVisible()
+    for (const tabName of [/details/i, /reviews/i, /shipping/i]) {
+      await tabs.getByRole('tab', { name: tabName }).click()
+      await expect(tabs.getByRole('tab', { name: tabName })).toHaveAttribute(
+        'aria-selected',
+        'true',
+      )
+      await expect(page.getByRole('tabpanel')).toBeVisible()
+    }
+  })
+
+  test('reveals answers to common questions on demand', async ({ page }) => {
+    const questions = page.getByRole('region', { name: /questions|faq/i })
+    const question = questions.getByRole('button').first()
+    await expect(question).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
+    await question.click()
+    await expect(question).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
+    await expect(questions.getByRole('region').first()).toBeVisible()
+  })
+
+  test('includes customer help, company, and social links in the footer', async ({ page }) => {
+    const footer = page.getByRole('contentinfo')
+    await expect(footer).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(footer.getByRole('link', { name: /help|contact/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(footer.getByRole('link', { name: /company|about/i })).toBeVisible()
+    await expect(footer.getByRole('link', { name: /instagram|facebook|social/i })).toBeVisible()
+  })
+})
